title: Nasruddin and the Clock
summary: A merchant brought an expensive bronze clock from Venice, boasting of its ticking accuracy....
full_text:
A merchant brought an expensive bronze clock from Venice, boasting of its ticking accuracy.

Nasruddin pointed to his stomach: "My clock is far superior! When my belly rumbles, it is noon; when my eyelids droop, it is bedtime; and it never needs winding with a key!"
moral: Nature provides its own clocks: appetite, sleep, and the sun.
